metaTitle: Cabinet Door Adjustment in Santa Monica | $135–$200
metaDescription: Cabinet doors sagging or misaligned in your Santa Monica home? Learn causes, what a pro does, and fixed pricing from $135 to $200.
intro: If your kitchen or bathroom cabinet doors have started to sag, stick, or hang crooked, you're not imagining it — this is a common issue in Santa Monica homes. The salt-laden coastal air here accelerates wear on hinges and hardware, causing doors that once closed smoothly to drift out of alignment.
causes: Hinges have loosened over time from repeated opening and closing.
Coastal humidity and salt air have caused corrosion or swelling on metal hinges and screws.
Wood cabinet doors have expanded or warped slightly due to moisture in the air.
The cabinet frame has shifted slightly, often from a home settling or nearby renovation work.
Cheap or worn hinge hardware has stretched past its ability to hold proper alignment.
whatProDoes: Inspects the hinges, screws, and cabinet frame to identify the source of misalignment.
Tightens, replaces, or repositions hinges and mounting screws as needed.
Adjusts the door using hinge cams or shims to restore proper alignment and even gaps.
Checks for corrosion on hardware common in coastal environments and replaces compromised parts.
Tests the door's swing and closure to confirm it sits flush and operates smoothly.
diyOrPro: Minor sticking or a slightly uneven door is often something a homeowner can try adjusting with a screwdriver, since most modern hinges have adjustment screws built in. If hardware is corroded, the frame itself seems warped, or multiple doors across the kitchen are affected, it's worth having a pro take a look so the fix actually holds instead of loosening again in a few weeks.
priceNote: This job runs $135 to $200 in Santa Monica, based on a rate of $83 per hour and jobs typically taking 1 to 2 hours. The exact time depends on how many doors need adjusting and whether hardware needs to be replaced due to coastal corrosion.

faqs.q: Why do my cabinet doors keep going out of alignment even after I tighten them myself?
faqs.a: In coastal areas like Santa Monica, salt air can corrode screws and hinge components over time, so a temporary tightening often loosens again. A pro can identify if the hardware itself needs replacing rather than just adjusting.

faqs.q: Can this be fixed the same day someone comes out?
faqs.a: Most cabinet door adjustments take 1 to 2 hours and are completed in a single visit, though the exact scope depends on how many doors are affected and their condition.

faqs.q: Will I need new hinges or just an adjustment?
faqs.a: It depends on the hinges' condition. If they're corroded or stretched out from coastal humidity, replacement may be necessary; if they're simply loose, a straightforward adjustment is usually enough.
